connector_materialization.source_bytes: The decoded UTF-8 content returned by the GitHub fetch_file/API response for the exact requested path and rules_source_sha is the canonical file content.
connector_materialization.write_rule: ChatGPT/Work must create parent directories and write that returned content directly to an ordinary local/container file at the same repository-relative path under the temporary materialization root.
connector_materialization.failure_rule: Do not treat the absence of an automatic connector filesystem mount, connector file reference, repository archive, checkout, or special materialization bridge as a blocker. Fail closed only when the exact source content cannot be fetched, cannot be written, or the required Python entrypoint fails after writing.

source_rule: Fetch every required_python_files and required_data_files path directly from the exact rules_source_sha using the GitHub API/connector. Treat the decoded response content itself as the source bytes and write it directly to an ordinary UTF-8 file preserving repository-relative paths. No automatic connector filesystem mount, special bridge, repository archive, checkout, .git directory or Git executable is required.

planner_state_placeholders.rule: For the explicit existence/uniqueness checks below, materialize zero-byte placeholder files for matching canonical repository paths. Their contents are not read by those checks.
